## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: HarvestRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
findByHive(hiveId: string): Harvest[] {
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A is the Hive itself: HarvestRepository looks up harvests by a hive id (`findByHive(hiveId: string)`). B is a Hive Scale, a weighing device. In ScaleService it is saved with its own serial number and points to a hive through a hiveId field (`this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber })`). The graph supports this split: ScaleService uses ScaleRepository for scales, a separate HiveRepository for hives, and WeightReadingRepository for readings looked up by serial number. So a scale is linked to a hive, not the same thing. Sharing a hiveId does not make them the same concept.
